Headcanon: the gift of telepathy has a subtle tendency to fuck with the heads of those gifted. Like subconsciously creating false memories out of the thoughts of the latest pop culture thing and whatnot the researcher talking to Blackwood has stuck in his head at the time. You could have fun with that since you always have blurred the line between what Blackwood's been through and what is verifiable.

Also I'm ill-suited for SCP entries yet well-suited for Foundation tales so by all means, give me a taste of your works in progress.

item.content:encoded:
I was the person who came up with the Robert Pattinson question (though not Smapti's brilliant answer). For me the humour isn't meant to be in the Twilight reference but character-based: lonely Brit, miles from home and feeling isolated, asks for some life lessons from a daring explorer whose work takes him thousands of miles from civilisation and then gets completely misinterpreted by journalists. And I think Smapti's answer develops on that really neatly and in a funny way. Though maybe not the one RPatz was looking for.

I deleted a previous question I put in this thread (an Inception reference) because I thought it didn't work-it didn't have any life beyond bringing some other fiction into the Foundationverse to make a not-too-funny joke.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
For what it's worth, I don't consider most of this page to be canon myself, aside from the stuff that directly touches on the material in my tales. The "real" Blackwood has never met Edward Cullen, Bill and Ted, Dr. Wondertainment's illiterate grandpa, been to the land of the Houyhnhnms, etc. I'm just working with the questions the site is throwing at me here, as a little way to have some fun with the character while I work through my writer's block and post the next legitimate Blackwood tale (which is turning out to be quite a doozy). Consider it a -J tale if the references rub you the wrong way too much.

EDIT: I have already authored a piece on this site that references both Lord Blackwood and AWCY. I will award one million internets to whoever identifies it first.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Aww man. So much for Canon. Lord Blackwood made a twilight reference.

I was also displeased about the Wondertainment reference. I know that it's tempting to weave in as many Foundation universe references as possible, I always saw Wondertainment as being a 20th century man. That is, after all, when the consumerism and novelty industry that Wondertainment represents was created. Next thing we know we'll see a AWCY reference, and then I'll have to shoot myself in the head.

My favorite thing about Lord Blackwood was that he wasn't a caricature. Though he had many adventures and knew much, he always felt grounded and real, like an explorer on the edge of the a terrifying world, not able to grasp the true extent of the horror. But now the trend is having him come into contact with everything Foundation related ever, and it feels like Jumping the shark. Especially the Darkblade reference. Eesh.
